tickets.text: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?

answer.title: How do I reset a forgotten account password?
answer.quote: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page. Enter your account email, then use the reset link. The link expires after 30 minutes. Support cannot read your password.
answer.source: Authored demo handbook / Account / Password reset

tickets.text: Where do I download a CSV export of my workspace data?

answer.title: How do I download my workspace data as a CSV export?
answer.quote: A workspace owner can open Settings, choose Export data, and select CSV. The export includes records visible to that owner. Large exports may take several minutes.
answer.source: Authored demo handbook / Workspace / Data export

tickets.text: How do I turn off the daily email digest?

answer.title: How can I stop the daily email digest notifications?
answer.quote: Open Profile, then Notifications. Switch Daily digest off and save. This changes digest messages only; security notifications remain enabled.
